scientific_integrity: All stationary-state expressions are credited to the primary source; the claim concerns its parameter-global negativity geometry, explicit transitions and angularly invisible negativity. Analytical derivations and finite numerical checks are distinguished.
scientific_limitations: Three-level truncated single Arosh oscillator with strictly positive loss and pump rates only.
Continuous-variable Wigner function of the embedded qutrit state, not a discrete qutrit Wigner representation.
No extension claimed to the full infinite-level oscillator or to other nonclassicality criteria.
Related general Wigner-positivity findings could imply some algebraic components; literature-wide novelty is not certified.
title: Complete Wigner-negativity topology and radial blind spots in a stationary qutrit oscillator
